column1: # Why OmaBoot? Live differs from the official Omarchy ISO: the rules the difference report applies
# (omaboot_release.py diff). AREA <tab> PATTERN <tab> CATEGORY <tab> EXPLANATION, tab-separated.
# AREA: package (a package the live edition adds), package-removed, iso (ISO 9660 files), esp (the
# EFI system partition), rootfs (the root file system). PATTERN: shell-style, the first match wins.
# Files of packages the live edition adds are explained by the package (and its dependencies are
# found automatically); configs/ changes in the fork are explained by their commits automatically.
# A difference no rule explains is "unexplained", and a release build fails on it.
